dedupe_keys.name: convenios firmados en el area nuclear nacional e internacional

description: Convenios firmados en el área nuclear, nacional e internacional is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Comisión Chilena de Energía Nuclear. Entrega información y permite entender la política externa de Chile en el área nuclear mediante su apego a tratados internacionales, bilaterales y multilaterales que promueven la no proliferación nuclear, el uso pacífico de la energía nuclear y la cooperación y colaboración vertical y horizontal. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Comisión Chilena de Energía Nuclear. Its tags are Acuerdos. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, JPEG. The portal shows 2015-10-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
